loop_join: The final beat p14 (short296_14.png), steam crossing the empty alley past a wall vent at night, is isCta and rewind:true so it plays backward under the FULL CASE card and holds on its last frame; frame 0 opens on p01 (short296_01.png), the alley's narrowest point where both walls close in, so the loop restarts on the same physical bottleneck the film opened on.
second_watch_detail: p08 shows the alley's slope read from the side, a stepped kerb rising, cut in early as an ordinary street detail; once L4 has explained that the slope 'decides which way the weight goes,' the same stepped kerb reads as the mechanism the whole short is measuring, not incidental texture.
